verdict.rationale: Kit documents a dedicated webhooks system that lets integrations react to account activity instead of polling. Its docs cover registering an endpoint, an event-type catalog (e.g. subscriber.unsubscribed and subscriber.bounced marked Available), signed deliveries verified with the endpoint secret, and retries with backoff up to 8 attempts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and full visibility into the event catalog beyond the excerpted events.
